name: Maru Yokokume
source:
Maru's career as a workers' rights activist began after a devastating construction accident. While drumming up support during the liability trial, she captured the attention of millions of Internetgoers with her audacious rhetoric and eccentric humor.

Since then, Maru and her "posse" of like-minded dissidents have devoted themselves to the protection of labor rights, initiating many successful strikes that easily defeated an onslaught of increasingly shameless corporate union busters. The favorable outcomes of these protests can be attributed to the compassionate and cohesive team environment that Maru and her friends created.

Bitokukawa Academy, a highly ethical organization with strong respect for its workers, was impressed by Maru's unwavering advocacy when she applied to Class 17. She will soon be attending the school as the Ultimate Activist, ready to scrutinize the school's treatment of its faculty — though she is unlikely to find fault.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/danganronpa/comments/1ffs8ec/meet_maru_the_former_ultimate_activist/]bio[/url]]
